title: Third Place Budget Quest
oneLiner: A playful social planner that turns broke friend groups into low-cost third-place adventures instead of another night online.
targetUser: Gen Z and millennial friend groups, student clubs, community organizers, local creators, and people trying to rebuild offline social rituals on tight budgets.
keyUX: Friends enter budget, transport limits, vibe, weather, and tolerance for awkwardness; the app generates a quest route with cheap/free stops, linger-friendly rules, mini-challenges, and a shareable recap card.
signalRefs: S9 - Reddit r/GenZ third spaces feel unaffordable
S10 - Reddit r/espresso hobby upgrade-path budget spiral
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype for "Third Place Budget Quest," a playful social planner that helps broke friend groups turn low-cost local places into offline adventures. Include: friend group budget and transport intake, vibe selector, third-place route board, linger score and hidden-cost warning, micro-challenge deck, awkwardness safety valve, bail-out plan, and shareable quest card/recap poster. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with bold social-game energy, tactile quest cards, local map snippets, expressive but readable colors, and shareable poster moments; it should feel like a friend-group adventure generator, not a conventional event calendar.
